note: F2-04 is not a separate file; decimal blocks are provided by F2-03.
sharedRestrictions: Original neon/chalk apparatus retained. Production approval is already settled by the 14 October master release; no stale fraction/TBD approval gate applies. Ready within each declared native numerical domain. Decimal numerals containing digit 4 remain caption-only under the existing pronunciation safeguard. Automated accessibility is not human screen-reader or all-device certification. Future lesson questions still need their own maths/content/layout review. Existing exported lessons embed source snapshots and must be regenerated.

components.name: Place value chart slider
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Nonnegative chart, thousands to thousandths, at most 4 whole digits and 3 decimal digits; integer shifts ±1–3 remain inside the native columns.
components.changes: Native lesson values and shift actions; centred visiblePlaces focusing preserves the original place identities; answer-worth concealment.

components.name: Counters on place value grid
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Hundreds to hundredths; 0–20 counters per column. Exchanges preserve weighted total; focus never relabels a column.
components.changes: Native exact count maps and exchange/break actions; centred column focus; computed answer removed from accessible question title.

components.name: Base ten blocks
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Whole or decimal scale; flats 0–9, rods 0–26, units 0–20. Decimal flat = 1, rod = 0.1, unit = 0.01.
components.changes: Native scale/count state and exchange/break actions; question title hides computed total; bounds match drawn block capacity.

components.name: Abacus gattegno chart
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Abacus hundreds to hundredths, 0–11 beads per rod; Gattegno thousands to hundredths, one digit 0–9 per row. Shifts stay inside native rows.
components.changes: Native abacus/Gattegno state and movement; row/rod focus, hidden-answer titles and lesson-aware reset; Gattegno viewport widened to include the existing rightmost tiles.

components.name: Column add and subtract animator
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Nonnegative operands through 9999.99; + or −. Subtraction requires a ≥ b; addition must remain below 10000. Native carry/borrow plans are rebuilt.
components.changes: Rebuild column plans from editable operands/op; native stage fast-forward/play; addition overflow refused.

components.name: Multiplication and division layouts
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Nonnegative operands through 4 whole digits and 2 decimal digits. Grid: no more than 4 nonzero parts per operand. Division: single digit 1–9 and terminating quotient within thousandths; recurring/longer quotients are rejected by lesson records and edited Explore operands.
components.changes: Native multiplication/division records; zero grid widths repaired; division readout now follows actual quotient digits; unsupported edited calculations rejected; read-only keyboard changes blocked.

components.name: Number expander
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Nonnegative thousands to thousandths; 4 whole digits and 3 decimal digits. Expansion 0–1; add/mult/pow/words forms. Zero remains visible.
components.changes: Exact custom expansion data; zero expansion retained; stable stage pointer capture and touch-action prevent touch cancellation on SVG redraw.

components.name: Standard form scaler
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Positive standard form, 1 ≤ mantissa < 10 with at most 3 decimal digits; exponent −6…6. All significant digits must fit the native −6…6 strip.
components.changes: Actual custom comparison values replace fixed comparison chips; custom mantissa/exponent actions; stable pointer capture and native-strip bounds.

components.name: Powers and roots builder
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Square/cube integer side 1–10; chain base 1–10, up to 8 factors. Law division requires a ≥ b; bounded combined chains.
components.changes: Fractional-index readout now uses correct dynamic cube-root equality and raised stacked chalk/neon 1/3. Native growth/laws configurable; stable pointer capture.

components.name: Bidmas collapsing tree
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Nonnegative number literals with + − × ÷ ^ and brackets; negative intermediate results allowed. At most 15 nodes, depth 5, expression length 120, finite intermediates within ±1 billion. Rounded nonexact readouts use ≈. Unary minus and algebraic symbols are unsupported.
components.changes: Custom validated expressions; native collapse order honours bracket depth before powers and left-to-right peers; editable initial Explore expression; rounded results visibly approximate.

components.name: Number bonds and ten frames
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: One or two ten frames; 0.1, 1 or 10 per counter. Filled cells are 0…10×frames. Partner stays unknown until reveal.
components.changes: Exact independent frame/unit/fill states and reset; native fill/reveal; accessible title conceals unknown partner.

components.name: Hundred square explorer
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Cells 1–100; marker 0 means no marker. Out-of-grid jumps are refused. Multiples/factors and native jump pills retained.
components.changes: Exact independent marker states and reset; jump/multiples/factor actions; grid cells now have proper grid/row parents.

components.name: Binary and other bases
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Bases 2,3,5,8,10; 8 binary places or 4 other-base places. Digits 0…base−1; denary input must be an integer within capacity.
components.changes: Exact independent base/digit states and reset; native carry/fill actions; fractional/blank denary input refused; read-only keyboard guard.

components.name: Number set classifier
components.previewRule: animated:true plays actions; static render previews start state. Explicit state/upto describes a selected working stage.
components.numericDomain: Exact integers, finite decimals, p/q, nonnegative square roots with optional leading minus, ±π, explicitly recurring decimal cards, and the original defined nonrepeating example. Ambiguous ellipses and zero denominators rejected. Up to 12 cards; regional tray capacity still needs lesson layout review.
components.changes: General exact numerical classification replaces fixed-card-only fallback; exact rational-root handling; stacked fraction cards; independent initial trays/reset; ambiguous ellipses rejected.
